steps.name: Anxious Old Man
steps.text: Ahem... Here we are, Señorita Weedy.

steps.name: Anxious Old Man
steps.text: This vehicle is used by the Inquisition to transfer documents between courts. It will not be under much scrutiny. The official letters I gave you should ensure safe passage.

steps.name: Anxious Old Man
steps.text: The coachman can be trusted, but the best he can do for you is pretend to take a nap as you pass through the borderlands...

steps.name: Anxious Old Man
steps.text: Take this money too. It's what little savings I have left, after all's said and done. It should come in handy on your way back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Anxious Old Man
steps.text: Go. Remember, you never saw me, and never visited the Salt Flat or Aarón. You've never returned to Iberia since you left...

steps.name: Anxious Old Man
steps.text: And once you're gone, never return again.
Two days ago

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: We're here, Señorita Weedy.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: ...I thought a handover involving Iberia, Ægir, and Rhodes Island would be taking place more openly, like the lighthouse that has been relit.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I see. So the Inquisition is concerned about me.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: You're clever.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Rhodes Island will hand over the Catastrophe warning system and medical center core components to the two Ægir consuls...

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Neither Iberia nor Ægir will keep official records of this handover. As such, it would be inconvenient for either Irene or Secunda to attend.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: And as a Rhodes Island operator who happens to be in Iberia, no one would be more qualified to oversee the handover. However—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: 'However, you're suspected of associating with bandits and interfering with the Inquisition's administration of justice at Aarón'?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Or is it, 'starting with your grandfather, your entire family are considered criminals by the Inquisition'?

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: No need to be so guarded. That era is in the past.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: But it remains the recent past, and some degree of vetting is still required.

spans.text: past, and some degree of vetting is still required.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: I expect you're familiar with this building?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Abuelo's old bionic lab.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: The Inquisition has sent all records associated with the Penia family's research here. Please review them so that we may archive them.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Then, you may begin the handover.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: The accumulated records are quite voluminous. I've assigned a clerk to assist you... I'm sure he'll be of help.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Someone who could help...

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Once you see him, I'm sure you'll understand that the Inquisition is acting in good faith.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Mm—*cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Old Clerk
steps.text: I forgot you were allergic to dust... I should've cleaned the place. It's been in disuse for many years.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I often saw you when I visited Abuelo here, Señor Callisto. Weren't you even more obsessed with cleanliness than I was?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Abuelo used to joke that your obsession with it was the only thing keeping you First Research Secretary, instead of taking his job.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Well, nowadays this old man is no more than a low-level clerk in the Inquisition, Señorita Weedy.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: If it weren't for my familiarity with these records, I wouldn't have even had the chance to leave my office... if you can call it that.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: So, how did you end up...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: L-Let's not talk about that, Señorita. We should begin.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: The Inquisition won't be giving either of us much time.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: This is the writ of sealing for the five bionic labs associated with the Penia family, one of which we're standing in right now. Please sign the last page once you've reviewed it.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: This is the notice of destruction of the relevant equipment. Please sign it too.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: This is... there's a lot of it.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I remember all these models and formulae...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Counting both published and unpublished, the Penia family has written a total of... 3782 papers on bionic science.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: What you're holding are the originals. All other extant copies have been destroyed.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: If you stacked them up, the originals alone must be almost as tall as I am... This must represent decades of work for Abuelo and the rest of you.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: After the Profound Silence, the Inquisition terminated all sea-related research in Iberia, but Señor Penia's bionics project went on until just a decade ago...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Compared to the thousands of projects snuffed out by the Inquisitors virtually overnight, we were the lucky ones.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Do you really think so?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: ...Another one, Señorita Weedy. Just sign on the last page if there's no issue.
In the derelict lab, the old man buries himself in the mountain of records, taking out paper after paper, summarizing them, then handing them over to Weedy.
His head is bowed, and Weedy cannot see his expression.
Is this how all old clerks end up, once their personalities are worn away by years of mundane work?
Quiet, rigid, patient, refusing to communicate outside of work, unemotional... almost like a machine.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: 'Bart, Dimar... stand accused of conducting experiments banned by the Inquisition to satisfy their private desires, terrorizing the local population...'

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: '...sentenced to life in the Bastión de Cánticos for such heinous acts.'

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: These are...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: The judgments... of those who participated in the project.
Hearing those names seems to bring about a change in the old clerk's voice.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: 'Dorren, Castro, Liam... bodies discovered in the Salt Flat after attempting to flee Iberia.'

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Please review and sign—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: 'Clara...'

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: 'Guilty of stealing Inquisition records and disseminating confidential experiment data without authorization... sentenced to ten years in the Bastión de Cánticos... died of illness during incarceration.'

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Clara... that Liberi lady with the golden hair? I remember that you and her...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: (Whispers) Pale gold.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: She had just come to the lab from Perdon. She was innocent, lively, pretty, and her cheer was infectious. Everyone wanted to talk to her.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: She helped us organize our data, while secretly developing a hair dye out of the seaweed we used in our experiments...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I could always smell a faint aroma when she walked past, one that reminded me of... the sea.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: She wasn't the kind of person they're saying she was, right?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: She just wanted to preserve the lab's research, the things that everyone poured their hearts and souls into...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Does it matter?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: The Inquisition needs justifications to shut down such a large research project. Whether they're true or not, nobody cares.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But she was your...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I'm lucky I wasn't implicated because of my relationship with Clara and your grandfather. The Inquisition gave me a path forward...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I-I'm very grateful to them.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Grateful?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Th-There is still much to do! Let's get back to the work at hand, Señorita.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: (Softly) *Sigh*...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: The next thing to review is...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: The main component of the lab's core project. In the original concept, it supported systems that could quickly sequence the genomes of marine creatures and create samples.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: It... It's not supposed to exist, not anymore...
The old man finally moves away from the mountain of papers, taking the tiny component from Weedy.
Weedy sees his expression—disbelief, realization, shock, scorn, pain, sorrow... A thousand emotions fill the face that was blank a moment ago.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: 'Disaster-bringing research'... 'corrupter of hearts'... 'beacon for the tides'...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: So the Inquisition never destroyed the thing they called disaster-bringing research... They wanted me to see it—no, for you to see it again...

spans.text: So the Inquisition never destroyed the thing they called disaster-bringing research... They wanted me to see it—no, for

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: What are they thinking?!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Are you still unwilling to talk, Señor?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I don't care what the Inquisition intends. Temptation, scrutiny, control—Iberians have long been used to such things...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What I care about is you, Señor.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I don't think you're just an emotionless puppet. From the moment you stepped into this lab, I'd been waiting...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Waiting to truly meet you again.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Señorita...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Don't worry, Leaf has already confirmed that there's no one else here.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I—I'm here to send you away from Iberia.
The old man grabs Weedy's sleeve and gazes straight into her eyes. His eyes are sharp and strong, as though he's become a different person.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: You should not have come back.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: We were fortunate to have connections in the Inquisition, which allowed Señor Penia to get advanced warning. He leveraged all the connections he had to get you out of Iberia...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: With dignity.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'd wanted to leave Iberia and see what was outside. I remember it being a smooth process, but the Inquisitor who processed my documents said it would be hard to come back once I left.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: None of that matters anymore.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Do not believe the finshit the Inquisitors tell you... 'That era is in the past'?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: No, it's not. Even if land and sea have joined hands again, even if your company is in a position to do business in Iberia.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: The Inquisition, their arrogance and tyranny, their cruelty and hypocrisy... None of it has changed.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Look at all these scrolls and records, this component that should have been destroyed...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I have no doubt now. Once you finish your business with Rhodes Island, they will demand that you forget everything that's happened, and that you restart the bionics research.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: As though—*cough *cough*—as though the crimes they committed, the shame and despair we felt, as though none of that ever existed!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Please, calm down. Are you alright?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: That's why, when that desgraciado told me you'd returned and ordered me to assist you, I knew I must send you away again!
The old man ignores Weedy's words and keeps talking.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: All the years I've spent on my knees have broken them, Señorita, but I've gotten a few things out of this...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Before I came, I spent my last savings to get my hands on some forged official letters that will get you past the checkpoints, and buttered up the powers that be...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: You will leave Iberia tonight.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You can't fool the Inquisition. It won't be long until they find out.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: None of it matters, as long as you're away from this country.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But the Inquisition will have your head!

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: No, Señorita Weedy—I will have THEIR heads.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Bart, Dimar...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Dorren, Castro, Liam...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Clara... oh, dear Clara...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: And your grandfather, Señor Penia... The lab is no more. Our science is no more. All that's left is a reputation in tatters...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: And an old man by the name of Callisto who yet lives, guarding these ruins.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I've been waiting for a chance!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You mean, me?

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I'll send you away, and wait for the alguacil and the Inquisitors to come here and draw their swords at me in anger, just like they once did!

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Then—*cough* then...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: I will spit my blood on the faces of those malditos one last time!
The old man screams until his voice is rasp, but he continues to clutch the component in its hand. Its sharp edges pierce his palms, which have become red with blood.
But the man continues to rage, as though it is the only emotion his feeble body can house.
As though this emotion has kept him alive all these years.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Promise me, Señorita!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I promise, Señor Callisto.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'll go.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: And once you're gone, never return again.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Get on, Señorita. I must get back to the lab. The Inquisition will be there any moment...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Alright... Leaf!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Pack up Señor Callisto and put him in the trunk... carefully.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: L-Let me go—what is the meaning of this?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: The money and the letters are right next to you. I've talked to the coachman, who will take a little detour, where you'll be met by a colleague of mine...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: A Liberi with a bright smile and a joking attitude, with a red streak in his white hair.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: He'll send you back to your old home... the town of Luarca you used to tell me about, on the fringes of the Salt Flat, where people dance around a bonfire at night.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: You can't do this! You promised me at the lab!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: ...Sorry, I lied.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: If I didn't, you'd have gone and found an Inquisitor to fight to the death, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'm an operator of Rhodes Island. Our continued existence depends on this handover. I must remain in Iberia to complete my mission.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Whatever the Inquisition meant by 'vetting', I'll find out myself.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Señorita—Weedy—girl! My body is like a piece of withered wood! I don't have many years left! Just let me fulfill this last wish...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Exactly! You don't have many years left.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Don't you realize, Señor? It's not just the Inquisition that's imprisoned you. It's also you yourself.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I still remember hearing you talk about why you joined the lab—the way you imagined massive bionic fins that would let us freely sail the seas...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But now, your memories contain only pain and hatred.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I want you to go home, even if you only have the time to taste the briny winds of the Salt Flat, to watch the saltfins leap from the salt...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: To talk to the young people dancing around the fire...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: To sleep soundly on a rocking chair...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I want you to live your last days in peace.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Let this vehicle bring the story of Penia Lab and everything my grandfather directed to a close, whether it's the sin the Inquisition claims it was, or the miscarriage of justice you believe it to be.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: You'll just let it go? Just like that?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Say goodbye to Señor Callisto, Leaf.
The bionic seadragon sways in front of the old man as though it is dancing.

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Callisto
steps.text: Could this be... a bionic seadragon...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It pales in comparison to what your team once achieved, but Leaf is indeed a product of bionic technology.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Science does not end because someone rejects it, nor does it depend on being recognized to continue.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: This is my way, and how I'll talk to them.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Adios, Señor.
Weedy takes a couple of steps back and pats the vehicle.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: —Now go, Coachman.
The old man says no more. Leaning against the interior of the vehicle, he gazes out the window at Weedy and the land behind her, until it all grows distant and blurred.
He gazes blankly, as though he has never known the girl, delicate yet strong; as though he has never known this land, never known... himself.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Let's go, Leaf.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: We have a lot to do.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Doña Irene.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Señorita Weedy has made a last-minute demand...

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: She wants the Inquisition to promise not to pursue the case of Señor Callisto?

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I see no reason to refuse.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: It seems you've misunderstood something.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Wh-What is it, Doña?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Vetting is indeed crucial for this handover of the Rhodes Island Catastrophe warning system and medical center core components, for it is of great importance to both land and sea.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: But it is not just Operator Weedy of Rhodes Island who is being put to the test. You and I, and the Inquisition itself... we are all being tested. Think about it.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: ...How we should face the past, and how we should approach the future in this new era.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Wrap up the vetting process for Operator Weedy. She has demonstrated that she is more than just the descendant of a sinner, or an obsessed scientist.

steps.name: Inquisition Official
steps.text: Understood.
